title: HackSprint 2026: 24-Hour Hackathon
description: Team up, build something real in 24 hours and pitch it to a panel of alumni and industry mentors.
details: HackSprint is the flagship overnight hackathon of the campus. Teams of 2–4 pick a problem statement from one of four tracks (Campus Life, Sustainability, FinTech, Open Innovation) and build a working prototype by morning. Mentors will be on the floor all night, and food and coffee are on us.

title: Git & GitHub Crash Course
description: From your first commit to your first pull request: a hands-on session for absolute beginners.
details: Bring your laptop. We will install Git together, learn branching, merging and resolving conflicts, and finish by contributing to a real open-source practice repository. Perfect if you've been copy-pasting code into Google Drive until now.

title: Anugoonj Cultural Night
description: An evening of dance, drama, fashion and stand-up performed by student societies from every school.
details: The biggest cultural evening of the semester. Expect classical and western dance performances, a street play from the dramatics society, a fashion walk and a stand-up comedy segment. Entry is free with your college ID card.

title: Inter-College Football Cup
description: Eight colleges, one trophy. Come cheer for the home team in the knockout rounds.
details: A one-day knockout tournament with 8 participating colleges. Quarter-finals in the morning, semis after lunch and the final under the evening lights. Spectators are welcome all day.

title: Resume & LinkedIn Teardown
description: Recruiters review real student resumes live and show exactly what gets shortlisted.
details: Submit your resume before the session and a few will be reviewed anonymously, live on screen. Learn how to write impact-driven bullet points, what ATS systems look for and how to make your LinkedIn profile work for you.

title: Acoustic Evening: Open Mic
description: Bring your guitar, your poetry or just yourself. Sign-ups open at the venue.
details: A relaxed evening under the lights at the OAT. Performers can sign up on the spot for 5-minute slots, whether it's a song, a poem or a short story. Unplugged and chill, no auditions.

title: Intro to Machine Learning with Python
description: Train your first model in a day: NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and a mini Kaggle-style challenge.
details: A full-day, hands-on workshop. The morning covers data handling with pandas and visualisation; the afternoon covers regression and classification with scikit-learn. We close with a mini competition on a real dataset.

title: Badminton Doubles Championship
description: Open doubles tournament for all years. Register your pair before the draw closes.
details: Men's, women's and mixed doubles categories. Matches are best of three games to 21. Shuttles provided; bring your own racquet and non-marking shoes.

title: Startup Founders Panel
description: Alumni founders talk about funding, failure and what they wish they knew in college.
details: Three alumni founders from edtech, D2C and SaaS sit down for an honest conversation about building companies straight out of college. Stay back for networking over chai.

title: Battle of Bands
description: Six college bands, one stage, loud amps. The crowd vote decides 30% of the score.
details: Bands from colleges across Delhi NCR compete with 20-minute sets judged by professional musicians. The audience vote counts too, so bring your friends.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint
description: Learn Figma by doing: redesign a real campus app screen in teams and present it.
details: We start with the basics of Figma (frames, auto layout, components) and move quickly into a design sprint where teams redesign one screen of a campus app. The best redesigns get featured on the club's page.

title: Photography Walk: Old Delhi
description: A sunrise photo walk through the lanes of Chandni Chowk. Phones welcome, no DSLR needed.
details: We leave from the main gate by metro and walk through Chandni Chowk, the spice market and Jama Masjid at golden hour. Mentors will share tips on composition and street photography etiquette. Breakfast stop included.

title: Competitive Programming Contest
description: A 2.5-hour ICPC-style contest with problems for every level, from your first AC to hard DP.
details: Individual contest hosted on a Codeforces gym. Eight problems ranging from beginner to advanced. Editorials and a discussion session follow the next day.

title: Annual Athletics Meet
description: Track and field events, relay races and the much-awaited faculty vs students tug of war.
details: The annual athletics meet features 100m to 1500m races, long jump, shot put and relays. The day ends with the traditional faculty vs students tug of war and the prize distribution.
highlights: Faculty vs students tug of war

title: Cloud & DevOps Bootcamp
description: Docker, CI/CD and deploying your first app to the cloud, all in one day.
details: Containerise a simple app with Docker, set up a GitHub Actions pipeline and deploy it to a free cloud tier. Ideal if your projects only ever run on localhost.

title: Mock Interview Day
description: One-on-one technical and HR mock interviews with seniors placed at top companies.
details: Book a 30-minute slot for a mock interview with a placed senior. You get written feedback on DSA, CS fundamentals and communication. Slots are limited and allotted first come, first served.
